answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 82 identities means 82 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the bridge pair is tracked in the timber ledger, the summit audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 37%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
